Option2Stmt.S: It is obtained from salicylic acid.

Option3Stmt.S: It has fewer side effects than salicylic acid.

Option4Stmt.S: It has stomach irritating side effects.

Solution.S: Aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid) contains an ester linkage, not an amide linkage. It is obtained from salicylic acid, has fewer side effects than salicylic acid, but does cause stomach irritation. Therefore, the false statement is that it contains amide linkage, which corresponds to option A.
